headline: Congress named a planned VA outpatient clinic in Colorado Springs, Colorado, after a World War II soldier, PFC Floyd K. Lindstrom.
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to a community-based VA outpatient clinic that was to be built at 3141 Centennial Boulevard in Colorado Springs. The clinic will be called the "PFC Floyd K. Lindstrom Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic." The law does not change how the clinic operates, what services it offers, or who can use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The naming took effect when the law was enacted on December 16, 2014.
